architectureFindings: Mandatory installed Sensor construction is validated for ordinary legal combat ships; the legal 35-Space envelope contains 11,776 builds and 37,184 exact TL1->TL2 progression edges.
The exact-edge architecture produced 181 populated strata, 362 deterministic lower->higher logical pairs, and 724 mirrored Adaptive Engage variants.
Safe-Strain capability memory remained clean with zero Strain-denied overload requests and zero combat-inactive variants in the substantive exact-edge screen.

Shield Capacity 3 and Armor AP0/AI5 show clean cross-TL defensive progression; Sensor DR1, Tactical Computer +12, and Early Practical Fusion 6 TP/6 Space remain healthy integration candidates; ECM2/ECCM2 remain strongly context- and power-dependent; Kinetic APEN1 is not meaningfully exercised until AP1 armor enters the broader progression envelope.
Mover order remains a major independent diagnostic and must stay mirrored rather than being conflated with technology progression.
